DrDucBook is a local-first reading and content-management app supporting Legado sources, compatible VBook plugins, ebooks, comics, audiobooks, editing, authoring, and optional AI tools.\n\nDrDucBook does not provide or host content sources. Users are responsible for the sources, accounts, and data they add. DrDucBook is an independent project built by learning from and extending Legado and legado-with-MD3; it is not an official release of Legado, legado-with-MD3, or VBook.
